content.title: Cameco's Westinghouse Becomes Big Winner From Trump's Nuclear Energy Push
content.summary: Cameco stock surged in Tuesday' stock market after the Canada-based uranium refiner announced it entered into a strategic partnership with the U.S. government, with its partial ownership of Westinghouse poised to play a major role in the acceleration and "deployment of nuclear power," following President Donald Trump's nuclear energy executive orders earlier this year.  The agreement with the U.S. government involves construction of at least $80 billion worth of new Westinghouse nuclear reactors across the country, according to Cameco.
